name: puretokens-skill
description: Installable Pure Tokens skills and skill management tooling.

scripts.validate: node scripts/validate-skills.mjs && node scripts/sync-skill-guidance.mjs --check && node scripts/sync-install-activation.mjs --check && node scripts/sync-skill-model-profiles.mjs --check && node scripts/sync-readme-media-catalog.mjs --check && npm run acceptance:validate && node scripts/executor-build-proof.mjs
scripts.release:validate: npm run validate && node scripts/validate-release-version.mjs && node scripts/check-media-catalog-freshness.mjs --max-age-days 7 && npm run executor:verify
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run executor:test && npm test
scripts.executor:test: cd runtime/executor && go test ./... -count=1 && go vet ./...
